portfolio.legal-notice.p-1: Controller The controller responsible for the processing of personal data on this website is:
portfolio.legal-notice.p-2: General Information The protection of your personal data is important to me. I treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with the applicable data protection regulations, in particular the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This Privacy Policy informs you about which personal data is processed when using this website and for what purposes.
portfolio.legal-notice.p-3: Hosting This website is hosted by netcup GmbH. When accessing the website, technically necessary data may be processed by the hosting provider. This may include, in particular: IP address Date and time of access Pages visited Browser type and browser version * Operating system used Referrer URL This data may be processed in server log files. The processing serves in particular to ensure the technical provision, security, and stability of the website.
portfolio.legal-notice.p-4: Contact Form This website contains a contact form that you can use to contact me. When you use the contact form, the data you enter is processed. This includes, in particular: * Name * Email address * Message The entered data is processed by a PHP application and sent to me by email using the PHP `mail()` function. The data submitted through the contact form is not stored in a database, file, or any dedicated permanent storage system on this website. The data is used exclusively to process your inquiry and contact you. The processing is based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR due to my legitimate interest in processing and responding to contact inquiries. If the contact leads to a contractual relationship or pre-contractual communication, the processing may additionally be based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR.
portfolio.legal-notice.p-5: Locally Hosted Fonts This website uses fonts that are stored locally on the web server and loaded from there. When these fonts are loaded, no connection to Google's servers is established. As a result, no personal data is transmitted to Google in connection with the use of these fonts.
portfolio.legal-notice.p-6: Language Preference Storage This website uses the browser's localStorage to store the language preference you have selected. Only the selected language preference, for example “de” or “en”, is stored locally in your browser. The language preference is not transmitted to my server and is not evaluated by me in a personally identifiable manner. The storage is used exclusively to retain your selected language when you visit the website again. You can delete the stored localStorage data at any time through your browser settings.
portfolio.legal-notice.p-7: External Links This website contains links to external websites, in particular GitHub and LinkedIn. When you click on one of these links, you leave this website and are redirected to the respective external website. The respective operators are responsible for the processing of personal data on these external websites. The privacy policies of the respective providers apply. I have no influence over the data processing carried out by these external providers.
portfolio.legal-notice.p-8: SSL/TLS Encryption This website uses SSL/TLS encryption for security reasons. You can recognize an encrypted connection by “https://” and the padlock symbol in your browser's address bar. The encryption is intended to protect transmitted data from access by third parties.
portfolio.legal-notice.p-9: Analytics and Tracking Services No analytics or tracking services are used on this website. In particular, services such as Google Analytics are not used. This website does not use personal data for advertising or tracking purposes.
portfolio.legal-notice.p-10: Your Rights Subject to the applicable legal requirements, you have, in particular, the following rights: Right of access to your personal data Right to rectification of inaccurate data Right to erasure of your personal data Right to restriction of processing Right to object to certain processing activities Right to data portability In addition, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority regarding the processing of your personal data.
portfolio.legal-notice.p-11: Updates to this Privacy Policy I reserve the right to amend this Privacy Policy if the technical circumstances of this website or the legal requirements change. Last updated: 08/09/2026
